title: Reverse the Message
statement: A message arrives as an array of characters. Reverse it in place (O(1) extra space) and return the reversed message as a string.

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers swapping from both ends
keyPoints: Move both inward until they meet
Join the array into a string
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Build a new reversed array: O(n) extra space

hints: Building a new array uses O(n) space. Which positions trade places?
The first and last characters swap, then the second and second-to-last, and so on.
Stop when the two pointers meet or cross.
